storage.purpose: To save user preferences for where to hide YouTube Shorts (homepage, search, panel, menu) and whether to block Shorts video playback
storage.usage: All settings are stored locally on the user's device using browser.storage.local API. No data is transmitted to external servers.

declarativeNetRequest.purpose: To redirect YouTube Shorts video URLs when the user has enabled the 'Disable video playback' option
declarativeNetRequest.usage: Creates a local redirect rule that blocks navigation to /shorts/ URLs and shows a blocking page instead. All processing is done locally in the browser.
